name: Wormwood-Sage Dual-Link SIC-POVM

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Belnap product lattice (Belnap)^n containing the d² equiangular vectors

VINIT.justification: The uninitialized state before the definition of dimension or vector space.

TANCH.justification: The closed set of d² vectors satisfying the equiangularity condition.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation of the fiducial vector across the group.

AREV.justification: The reverse mapping from the vector space back to the operator basis.

CLINK.justification: The sequential application of unitary displacements to the fiducial seed.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the base vector under the Zauner symmetry group.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the fiducial search into the Wormwood (descent/AREV) and Sage (ascent/AFWD) paths.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the unified SIC-POVM from the dual-link branches.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative confirmation that the inner product satisfies the 1/(d+1) constraint.

EVALF.justification: The negative result where vectors fail the equiangularity condition.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice state where a vector is both a member and a generator simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the verified SIC-POVM structure in the append-only ledger.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the computational vacuum for dimension d
Define the identity of the initial fiducial candidate
Branch the candidate into dual-link processing paths
Apply Sage ascent via Weyl-Heisenberg displacement operators
Verify the Sage branch satisfies the equiangularity bound
Apply Wormwood descent via adjoint projection and parity flip
Check for potential orthogonality violations in the descent path
Reconstitute the dual-link results into a single vector set
Compose the full d² set of projections from the fused result
Hold the Belnap fixed point state for the multilattice structure
Record the verified SIC-POVM into the Lean 4 proof environment
Seal the boundary of the completed equiangular system

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The transformation is a unitary rotation preserving the information content of the fiducial.
